_note: FICTIONAL market and news events for the Aurelius learning project. Not real companies, not real news.

events.headline: XYZ Corp misses Q3 estimates; shares fall 9% on the week
events.summary: Revenue grew 4% against 7% expected; management cut full-year guidance citing weaker enterprise spending.

events.headline: Firm research keeps XYZ at Hold and trims its price target
events.summary: Analysts see slower growth for two quarters; the house view repeats that single stocks should stay under 10% of a portfolio.

events.headline: Central bank holds rates steady, signals one more cut this year
events.summary: Bond prices rose modestly after the announcement; investment-grade bond funds gained about 0.4% on the day.

events.headline: ABC Industries announces two plant closures; shares drop 6%
events.summary: The company will close two older plants by mid-2027 and take a restructuring charge. Pension plans are not affected.

events.headline: Emerging-market stocks slide as the dollar strengthens
events.summary: Broad emerging-market equity indexes fell about 4.5% over three sessions.

events.headline: Aurelius International Bond Fund (AIBF) cuts its fee and changes benchmark
events.summary: The expense ratio falls from 0.20% to 0.15% on November 1. No action needed from shareholders.

events.headline: US stocks close at a record high
events.summary: Broad US equity indexes rose about 1.8% over the week, led by industrial and financial stocks.

events.headline: European central bank cuts rates by a quarter point
events.summary: International developed-market bonds and stocks rose slightly.
